system.description:
Weapon Kit — A support gun firing tranq darts, with glob, fumigate and healing options.

Tranq Dart (basic) — 1 Action. Range 8, Damage: 1d4 Piercing. On hit: 1d4 Acid damage.

Toolbelt (2 Actions):

  • Glob Shot. Range 8. Target is Slowed, 1 minute. It bounces to the next nearest target in Range 8. If it's an enemy they are also Slowed; if it's an ally they gain +2 speed once, 1 minute.
  • Fumigate. Cone 3, Damage: 3d4 Acid. Allies take no damage and you heal 1 negative condition from allies in the area (not including Wounds).
  • Super Elixir. Range 8, Blast 3, Restore: INT HP. Each ally regains the same amount at the start of their next turn.

High Levels: +6 Acid damage every 5 levels (Tranq Dart & Fumigate). +2 bonus every 5 levels (Super Elixir).

[A] Grants the Elixir Gun item (basic ability, 1 Action, no scrap) and one feature per Toolbelt option (2 Actions, 1 Toolbelt scrap each, spent natively). Scraps are tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] High-level damage/healing bonuses are built into the formulas.

[M] Weapon Kits count as weapons for swapping and stowing.
